text: 5-year-old boy. The patient is presented by his mother for a well-child visit. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Hypertension (Note: Per clinical guidelines, a diagnosis of hypertension in a 5-year-old requires at least three separate elevated BP readings; a single finding on a well-child visit is typically classified as "Elevated Blood Pressure" pending re-measurement, as this condition is unlikely to cause systemic symptoms at this age without underlying renal or cardiac pathology).
